ch8_lab_images.title: Quick Check: Image Formats, Compression & Rights

questions.q: Which type of compression permanently deletes some image data to shrink file size, and is best used for large, complex photographs (like JPG or WebP)?
options: Lossless compression
Lossy compression
Dithering
Vector compression

questions.q: Why is SVG the best format for a logo that needs to look crisp on both a business card and a billboard?
options: SVG files are always smaller than JPGs no matter what
SVGs are made of mathematical paths, not pixels, so they scale to any size without ever getting blurry
SVG is the only format browsers support
SVGs automatically compress themselves

questions.q: A client tells you a photo is 'royalty-free' so you can use it for nothing. Is that correct?
options: Yes, royalty-free always means completely free of cost
No -- royalty-free means you pay once (or use a free tier) and can reuse it many times; it does not mean 'free of cost'
No, royalty-free means you can never use the image
Yes, but only for non-commercial projects

questions.q: Which attribute MUST be paired with autoplay on a <video> tag for browsers to actually allow it to play automatically?
options: loop
controls
muted
poster

questions.q: What is the purpose of the <track> tag inside a <video> element?
options: It sets the video's file size
It links a .vtt file to provide subtitles/captions for deaf and hard-of-hearing users
It controls the video's autoplay behavior
It adds a poster thumbnail image

questions.q: Why should you add a sandbox attribute to an <iframe> that embeds untrusted third-party content?
options: It makes the iframe load faster
By default an iframe has full permissions (can run scripts, submit forms); sandbox restricts those permissions, and you only add back what's specifically needed
sandbox is required for all iframes to display at all
It changes the iframe's aspect ratio

ch8_lab_tablesfit.title: Quick Check: Semantic Tables, Object-Fit & Accessibility

questions.q: Which HTML table attribute stretches a single cell horizontally across multiple columns?
options: rowspan
colspan
thead
tfoot

questions.q: What's the key difference between object-fit: cover and object-fit: contain?
options: They behave identically
cover scales and crops the image to fill the entire box with no empty space; contain shrinks the image to fit entirely inside the box, possibly leaving empty bars
contain always distorts the image; cover never does
cover only works on video, contain only works on images

questions.q: In the POUR accessibility principles, what does it mean for a site to be 'Operable'?
options: The site must load in under 1 second
The site must be fully usable and navigable using just a keyboard, not only a mouse
The site must use only one color
The site must have a search bar
